scope: Settings of the archived five-design follow-up package, not later six-layout experiments or historical optimization-population validation.
report_role: New descriptive documentation of existing archived runs; no new experiment or changed acceptance criterion.

common.initialization: Normal DC operating point; no forced initial state in the PT comparison.
common.output_save: Selected explicit signals; simulator saved sample times are retained, not resampled for metrics.

models.family: Public PTM-MG 14 nm high-performance NFET and PFET predictive compact models
models.simulation_corner: One nominal predictive-model condition; no process-corner distribution or mismatch sweep.
models.provenance: Model identity is established from the archived NFET/PFET files and their model-card comments. No transistor models are distributed in this results-only supplement.

common.completion_interpretation: A zero-error completed run supports its recorded numerical solution. It is not a claim that all electrical specifications pass. Each native log retains warnings and notices.
common.common_warning: The model cards declare bulkmod twice, producing two SFE-32 warnings. The supplied cards are unchanged. Some transient logs additionally report trapezoidal ringing notices; these remain visible.

network_conditions.unit_collapse: Ideal-interconnect control using the same positional/unit device decomposition and predictive models as the corresponding RC/RCC run. Unit terminals collapse to ideal source nets; geometry-derived R/C is absent. This is not the original long-channel schematic.
network_conditions.RC: Unit-terminal distributed metal/via resistance and ground capacitance, including supply/ground interconnect. Device L/NFIN/NF/M, stimulus, load and bias match unit_collapse for each design.
network_conditions.RCC: Same RC network plus a restricted nominal-track coupling sensitivity estimate; not a separately calibrated full coupling extraction.
network_conditions.resistance_formula: R_ohm = UnitR_ohm_per_um * length_um * nominal_width_nm / actual_width_nm; physical via cuts contribute per-cut resistance.
network_conditions.ground_capacitance_formula: C_fF = UnitC_fF_per_um * length_um; split equally between the two segment endpoints.
network_conditions.coupling_formula: Ccouple_fF = 0.1 * parallel_overlap_um for the eligible same-layer nominal-width segments on adjacent tracks one layer pitch apart; different nets and no intermediate obstacle.
network_conditions.coupling_outside_eligibility: Not modeled/unknown, not an assertion of zero coupling.
network_conditions.coupling_calibration: Adding coupling to the ground-capacitance abstraction is a sensitivity construction; no measured ground/coupling partition calibration is established.
network_conditions.FEOL: Active/poly device-interior conduction uses the declared ideal device connectivity; well/substrate/contact parasitics are not a calibrated foundry extraction.
network_conditions.technology_coefficients_origin: ALIGN mock14 layer abstractions. A commercial simulator does not make these coefficients calibrated PEX.

CLK-CMP.recorded_probe: Six fixed clocked comparisons at 9,19,29,39,49,59 ns; complementary 80/20-percent voltage levels.
CLK-CMP.specification_scope: Selected clocked-comparison response, not exhaustive comparator timing/metastability characterization.

bias_selection.status: Adaptive bounded follow-up after prior measured operating points; not an initially preregistered operating condition. The last candidate and stopping rule were fixed before its own results.
bias_selection.RCC_rule: RCC at the same final bias was added once after RC passed the fixed low<0.16/high>0.64 probe.

CT-CMP.recorded_probe: Settled low average at [18,24) ns <0.16 V and high average at [8,14) ns >0.64 V.
CT-CMP.specification_scope: A measured fixed response at the declared adjusted bias; not an unmodified nominal-bias result or PVT margin guarantee.

DC-Switch.recorded_probe: Four clamped-rail output nodes at five times; 20 voltage checks with absolute error below 0.1 V.
DC-Switch.power_scope: Reports VSUP and each externally driven rail separately. Ideal clock-driver energy is not included. VMID average power can be negative because energy returns to that source.
DC-Switch.specification_scope: Externally clamped switching-core rail transfer; not full DC-DC converter efficiency or regulation.

device_sizing_intervention.kind: New follow-up design, with two sensing-inverter transistor sizing changes; not a P&R-only repair of the historical experiment.

PT-CMP.unit_decomposition: The sized PMOS is represented by two parallel NF=2, NFIN=12 unit MOS devices in new-layout unit/RC/RCC, versus one NF=4, NFIN=12 device in the 53-instance prior sizing control. Other 52 family declarations agree. This declaration relation is not assumed to prove numerical compact-model equivalence.

stimulus.initial_state: Normal DC solution; no forced initialization.

PT-CMP.recorded_probe: Eight fixed words; output high if all four adjacent bit pairs are equal, otherwise low. Sample at 9+10*i ns and require >=0.64 V or <=0.16 V.
PT-CMP.plot_fourth_curve: Prior sizing control, not original-source schematic. Its raw data are a separate existing simulation and are not one of the 15 new-layout unit/RC/RCC runs.
PT-CMP.specification_scope: Eight selected word responses after the declared sizing intervention; not a proof that all original historical layouts are electrically valid.

bias.selection_scope: New declared bias/reference-interface follow-up. It does not restore or certify an unspecified original precision-buffer application.

feedback.VFB1: Zero-volt source between out and fbin; local STB probe.
feedback.VFB2: Zero-volt source between fb2 and vbp2; remains closed during VFB1 STB.

REF-BUF.observer_recovery: One failed newly added wildcard operating-parameter observer was removed; the final selected-save run retains the same circuit/model/analysis/stimulus. Failed prior attempt is retained privately and is not a successful result.
REF-BUF.recorded_probe: Positive finite settled response (high>low) only; step gain, DC tracking error and settling times are measured without a precision-specification pass.
REF-BUF.specification_scope: No original full precision-buffer specification or global multi-loop/PVT stability pass is established by these data.
